content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

- **§12.3 (p0051)** affirmatively negates any restraint on Customer: free to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, with an express acknowledgement that Customer made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. That satisfies the sole preferred element.
- **§12.4 (p0052)** is a restraint on *Vendor* (no competing service against Customer's analytics products during the term) — beneficial to us, so not flagged.
- Swept the remaining plausible locations: §2.1 (no minimum purchase or volume commitment), §13.1–13.4 (non-exclusive worldwide access plus ordinary anti-reverse-engineering/anti-interference rules, expressly not limiting use of Customer Data and output), §14 (Customer ownership; no field-of-use limit), §25 publicity, §26 compliance, §30 general — none imposes a non-compete, field-of-use, or territory restriction on us.

No redline proposed.
